info.title: AgentSkills CLI
info.description: The .NET commandline tool for the open Agent Skills ecosystem. Install skills from GitHub, NuGet, npm, well-known endpoints, or local folders into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, and any spec-compliant agent.

commands.name: add
commands.description:
Install one or more skills from a local folder, GitHub repo, git URL, or
NuGet/npm package

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --global
options.description:
Install to the user-wide directory instead of
the project

options.name: --agent
options.description:
Target specific agents (claude-code, codex,
cursor, opencode, universal)

options.name: --skill
options.description: Install specific skills by name. Use '*' for all

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip interactive prompts and accept defaults

options.name: --copy
options.description:
Copy files into each agent directory instead of
symlinking

options.name: --symlink
options.description: Force symlink mode (default)

options.name: --nuget-source
options.description:
Override NuGet feed (otherwise the user's
NuGet.config feeds are used)

options.name: --npm-registry
options.description:
Override the default npm registry (otherwise
~/.npmrc / project .npmrc + per-scope rules
apply)

options.name: --path
options.description:
Restrict discovery to a subdirectory of the
source. Overrides any subpath the source string
carried (e.g. a GitHub /tree/.../path URL). Use
when a package puts its skills somewhere
non-conventional

arguments.name: SOURCE
arguments.description:
Local path, GitHub shorthand (owner/repo), URL, or NuGet package
id

commands.name: find
commands.description:
Search registered providers (skills.sh and any you register) and install a
result

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip the install confirmation when picking a result

options.name: --global
options.description:
Install the chosen skill globally instead of into
the project

options.name: --provider
options.description:
Restrict the search to specific providers (e.g.
skills.sh). Repeatable. Omit to fan out across
every enabled provider

options.name: --list-providers
options.description: Print the registered search providers and exit

arguments.name: QUERY
arguments.description: Search query. When omitted, you'll be prompted interactively

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --yes
options.description: Overwrite an existing SKILL.md without asking

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Directory to scaffold a SKILL.md in. Defaults to current directory

commands.name: list
commands.description: List installed skills grouped by agent or package

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --global
options.description: List globally installed skills

options.name: --agent
options.description: Limit to specific agents

options.name: --by
options.description:
Group the output. Valid values: package, path,
agent, scope. Default is a flat table

options.name: --paths
options.description:
Include a column with each skill's on-disk install
path

arguments.name: TARGETS
arguments.description:
Only list skills matching these targets. Each argument is
matched as a skill name first, then as a source (any shape
`add` accepts). Omit to list everything

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --global
options.description: Remove globally installed skills

options.name: --agent
options.description: Limit removal to specific agents

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip the confirmation prompt

arguments.name: TARGETS
arguments.description:
Skills to remove. Each argument is matched as a skill name
first, then as a source (any shape `add` accepts: GitHub
owner/repo, GitHub/GitLab URL, npm package id, NuGet package
id, local path). Omit to be prompted

commands.name: update
commands.description: Check tracked skills for upstream updates and (optionally) reinstall

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --global
options.description: Limit to globally installed skills

options.name: --project
options.description: Limit to project-installed skills

options.name: --yes
options.description: Auto-confirm any updates instead of prompting

options.name: --check
options.description: Only report drifted skills; don't install updates

arguments.name: SKILLS
arguments.description:
Only check these skill names. Omit to check everything tracked
in the lock

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information
